pos.label: POS / Counter
pos.why: A professional practice never rings up a walk-in counter sale — it invoices.

quotations.label: Quotations
quotations.why: A counter kitchen does not quote before serving. Catering and contract kitchens do, so they keep it.

sales_orders.label: Sales Orders
sales_orders.why: Dine-in and counter food is served, not ordered ahead against a book. Contract kitchens are the exception.

recurring_invoices.label: Recurring Invoices
recurring_invoices.why: Nobody bills a walk-in tea shop customer monthly. Contract kitchens do run standing orders.

b2b_proposals.label: B2B Proposals
b2b_proposals.why: Multi-item business proposals belong to trades that pitch for contracts.

park_recall.label: Hold / Park & Recall
park_recall.why: Holding a bill needs a counter to hold it at.

table_service.label: Table & Floor Service
table_service.why: Floor plans and kitchen tickets only exist where there is a floor. Trucks, dark kitchens and caterers have none.

pre_sales.label: Pre-Sales Reservation
pre_sales.why: Reserving stock against a future sale needs stock that keeps.

inventory.label: Inventory
inventory.why: A practice that sells only its own time holds no stock.

stock_transfers.label: Stock Transfers
stock_transfers.why: There must be two places before stock can move between them.

batches_expiry.label: Batches & Expiry
batches_expiry.why: Batch and expiry tracking is for goods that spoil, or that regulation makes you trace.

serials.label: Serials / IMEI
serials.why: Serial and IMEI tracking is for high-value units you must identify one by one.

variants.label: Product Variants
variants.why: Size, colour and fit only matter where the same product comes in a run.

barcodes_labels.label: Barcodes & Labels
barcodes_labels.why: Labels need a catalogue and stock behind them.

units_of_measure.label: Units of Measure
units_of_measure.why: Conversions apply to goods, not to hours.

purchase_orders.label: Purchase Orders
purchase_orders.why: A purchase order is a purchase you have not received yet.

purchase_returns.label: Purchase Returns / Debit Notes
purchase_returns.why: You can only send back what you bought.

landed_cost.label: Landed Cost Allocation
landed_cost.why: Freight, duty and clearing only load onto cost when goods cross a border or move in bulk.

cookbook.label: Cookbook / Recipes (BOM)
cookbook.why: A recipe or bill of materials only exists where you turn inputs into something else.

production_runs.label: Production Runs
production_runs.why: Production runs need a workshop or a kitchen that makes, not just resells.

composite_items.label: Composite / Auto-Deducting Items
composite_items.why: Bundles and kits need goods to bundle.

bank_reconciliation.label: Bank Reconciliation
bank_reconciliation.why: There must be a bank account to reconcile against.

loyalty_gift.label: Loyalty & Gift Cards
loyalty_gift.why: Points and gift cards work on walk-in consumers, not on trade buyers.

marketplace_sync.label: WooCommerce / Marketplace Sync
marketplace_sync.why: There has to be a catalogue of goods to list online.
